description: Look up one or more genes by symbol in a given organism and get NCBI's authoritative record: Entrez gene id, official description, biotype, chromosome and orientation, RefSeqGene coordinates, and the cross-references that let you join to other databases — HGNC id, Ensembl gene ids, UniProt/Swiss-Prot accessions, OMIM ids — plus every known synonym and alternate name. AUTHORITATIVE for gene-identifier resolution: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH when you need to turn a symbol into a stable id, disambiguate an alias, or check that a symbol is current for the species you think it is.

symbols.description: Gene symbol, or several comma-separated: "BRCA1", "TP53,BRCA1,EGFR". Results come back in upstream order — match on the returned symbol, not on position.

taxon.description: Organism as tax id, scientific name or common name. Default "human". Symbols are species-specific, so this matters.

name: ncbi_gene_by_symbol
